pairs.question: Quare inter ceteras liberales disciplinas Medicinae ars non contineatur?
pairs.answer: Propterea, quia illae singulares continent causas, ista vero omnium.
pairs.derivation: Authorial self-posed question. Dropped the framing narration 'Quaeritur a quibusdam' (narrates the asking), keeping the indirect-question clause 'quare inter ceteras liberales disciplinas Medicinae ars non contineatur' as the interrogative; normalized capitalization of the first word and added a terminal '?'. Answer ends at the first full stop: 'Propterea, quia illae singulares continent causas, ista vero omnium.' What follows ('Nam et Grammaticam medicus scire debet...') begins elaboration of why medicine touches all disciplines, so it is excluded. Stripped the section marker '[1]' scaffolding.
